items.title: George Russell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: No, they sang – sometimes they would sing Bach.

ctx.x: What was the repertoire of the singers? Was it sort of like the Fisk Jubilee Singers? Or was it a more modern version of that?
No, they sang – sometimes they would sing Bach. But then we would get down to business and sing black music, sing the black folk music.
But sometimes they would sing Bach, huh?
